title: BACKND Base message (player-to-player notes)
summary: Player-to-player messages (notes): send a message to a gamer inDate (SendMessage), list sent and received messages, and delete sent or received messages. Message length is capped by console configuration.
capabilities: route note/message send and list questions
distinguish sent vs received message management
prerequisites: SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
Recipient gamer inDate is known when sending
common_pitfalls: Confusing sent vs received list/delete operations
Confusing player messages with the post/mailbox system
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating message code.
Confirm the length limit and delete behavior upstream.
public_notes: Messages are 1:1 player notes, distinct from the post/mailbox system.
Length is limited by console configuration.
